description: This file defines the public interface for evaluating a guess against a target word, checking win/lose conditions, but contains only stub functions with no implementations. It serves as a contract to be implemented, likely for a Wordle-like game logic.

methods.name: evaluateGuess()
methods.description: Evaluates a guess against the target word, returning an array indicating the status of each letter ('correct', 'present', 'absent'). Currently unimplemented, raises an error.

methods.name: isWin()
methods.description: Determines if the current result indicates a win. Currently unimplemented, raises an error.

methods.name: isLose()
methods.description: Determines if the game has been lost based on attempts. Currently unimplemented, raises an error.
